brief: Charitable trust site for people, pets and planet causes. Goal: elegant, emotional, trust-building UI with advanced scroll/hover animation that converts visitors into donors.

usage.forest800: primary brand color — headings, primary buttons, icons
usage.gold600: reserved ONLY for donation CTAs and emotional accent moments — never used decoratively
usage.cream50: page background (not pure white — warmer, more organic)
usage.forest950: dark sections — footer, impact band, mobile menu

usage.italicEmphasis: Fraunces italic — used specifically for emotional lines and pull-quotes (e.g. hero 'Good Deeds', testimonial quotes)
usage.eyebrow: Manrope 700, 0.75rem, letter-spacing 0.14em, uppercase, prefixed with an 18px gold rule

signatureElement.name: RootLine
signatureElement.description: Hand-drawn root/vine SVG that draws itself (stroke pathLength animated on scroll) — used as section dividers and as an ambient background trace. Literalizes 'Rooted in Good Deeds' instead of using a generic divider or gradient blob.
variants: ambient (vertical, low-opacity background accent behind hero/footer/CTA)

motionPrinciples: Every section reveals on scroll: opacity 0->1 + translate 40-56px, duration 0.7-0.8s, ease cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), triggers once at 20-25% in view
Stat numbers count up from 0 when they enter viewport (spring-based, ~1.8s)
Primary CTA buttons are 'magnetic': content translates toward cursor on hover (strength 0.35), springs back on leave
Navbar is floating glass pill, condenses opacity/shadow after 24px scroll
Custom dot+ring cursor on desktop only, expands and shows a text label over elements tagged data-cursor
Page scroll uses Lenis for eased inertial scrolling

components.name: Reveal / Stagger / StaggerItem
components.purpose: wraps any element for scroll-triggered entrance, with staggered children support

components.name: Icons
components.style: 1.7px stroke, 24x24 viewBox, currentColor — one consistent hand-built family, not a generic icon pack

pages.name: HomePage
sections: Hero — eyebrow, 2-line serif title with italic emphasis word, supporting paragraph, Donate Now + Become a Volunteer buttons, framed hero image with play button and floating stat badge
Stat strip — 5 stats (Projects/Lives/Children/Animals/Villages) in a white card that overlaps hero and content, count-up numbers
About teaser — 3-column: framed photo with ribbon | headline + copy + checklist + CTA | Gandhi pull-quote card
Key Activities — 6 cards (People/Pets/Planet/Community Development/Volunteer/Donate With Love), icon + title + checklist
Impact band — dark forest section, headline + 'See Our Reports' button on left, 6 count-up stats on right
Featured Projects — 4 cards with image, location, progress bar, raised/goal amounts, Support Project button
Trust strip — 4 items (100% Transparent / Secure Donations / Tax Benefits / Regular Updates)
Stories of Hope — 3 testimonial cards with quote icon, avatar, name, role
Final CTA — centered headline + paragraph + Donate Now + Get In Touch buttons, ambient RootLine background

pages.name: CausesPage
sections: Alternating People/Pets/Planet feature sections divided by RootLine

assetsNeeded.logo: src/assets/logo (SVG preferred) — currently a drawn leaf-mark SVG in Logo.jsx as placeholder
assetsNeeded.projectThumbnails: src/assets/projects/ — 4 images (education, animal rescue, tree plantation, food distribution)
assetsNeeded.partnerLogos: src/assets/partners/ — TATA, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Reliance Foundation, Axis Bank, Tech Mahindra
